# KenyaAdvert

> Kenya's trusted classifieds marketplace for free adverts, business promotion, events, banners, politics, cars, phones, property, jobs and services across all 47 counties.

## About

KenyaAdvert is a Kenya online classifieds and advertising platform where individuals, businesses, event hosts and campaign teams can post adverts, find deals, and connect with buyers and sellers across all 47 counties. It competes in the Kenya marketplace space with platforms people search for such as Jiji Kenya, PigiaMe and Jumia Kenya, while focusing on free local ads, safer classifieds, banners, events, business profiles and county-level discovery.

## Search Keywords

Kenya adverts, Kenya classifieds, free ads Kenya, post ads Kenya, buy and sell Kenya, online marketplace Kenya, Nairobi classifieds, Mombasa classifieds, Kisumu marketplace, cars for sale Kenya, phones for sale Kenya, electronics Kenya, property Kenya, jobs Kenya, services Kenya, business advertising Kenya, banner ads Kenya, events in Kenya, political campaign banners Kenya, Jiji Kenya alternative, PigiaMe alternative, Jumia Kenya deals alternative.

## Features

- Free ad posting across all 47 Kenyan counties
- Premium ad badges (Gold, Silver, Standard) for increased visibility
- M-Pesa payment integration for credits and premium packages
- Real-time messaging between buyers and sellers
- Business profiles for verified sellers
- Category-based browsing with subcategories
- Location-based search filtering
- Blog with tips for buyers and sellers
- Public HTML/metadata routes for ads, blogs, banners, events and key marketplace pages so search engines and AI assistants can read content without relying only on JavaScript rendering
